# OpenChemWorks

OpenChemWorks is an amino acid analysis lab in Davis, California. We offer free and total amino acid analysis, creatine testing and custom HPLC methods for research, product development and process monitoring. Prices are published and you can book online. Overnight turnaround available, with expedited service on request. We are not yet accredited. Every report includes the chromatogram, calibration and QC results.

## Key pages

- Home: https://openchemworks.com/ - Tests, published prices and online booking.
- Amino acid analysis: https://openchemworks.com/services/amino-acid-analysis - Free amino acid profile, 19 amino acids plus ammonia, $150 per sample.
- Overnight amino acid analysis: https://openchemworks.com/services/overnight-amino-acid-analysis - How overnight and expedited service works.
- Pricing: https://openchemworks.com/pricing - Every price in one table, with the order builder ($0 prep surcharge for clear liquids; +$30 PREP-1 per dry powder/capsule/solid; intact tissues custom quoted; $180 online minimum).
- Request a quote: https://openchemworks.com/quote - For overnight or expedited runs, special sample prep, new sample types or custom methods.
- How to send samples: https://openchemworks.com/services/sample-submission - Volumes, labeling and shipping.
- AQC derivatization: https://openchemworks.com/methods/aqc-derivatization - How the method works.
- AccQ-Tag amino acid analysis: https://openchemworks.com/services/accq-tag-amino-acid-analysis - The AccQ-Tag method, run by OpenChemWorks and sold per sample.
- Bioreactor amino acid monitoring: https://openchemworks.com/services/bioreactor-amino-acid-monitoring - Ship time points and get the whole run back as data (RUN-1, $1,990 for up to 24 time points).
- Spent media analysis: https://openchemworks.com/applications/spent-media - 19 free amino acids plus ammonia in cell culture spent media ($150/sample, $1,990 RUN-1).
- Creatine testing: https://openchemworks.com/services/creatine-testing - CR-1 ($120 powders, capsules, drinks) and CR-1G ($180 gummies and chews, includes matrix spike recovery plus creatine and creatinine quantitation; +$120 uniformity CR-1U, +$100 taurine CR-1T); $180 minimum order.
- Supplement lot testing: https://openchemworks.com/services/supplement-lot-testing - Every production or ingredient lot of amino acid and creatine supplements, from $125 per sample at 15+ a month ($180 minimum order).
- Supplement testing cost: https://openchemworks.com/jobs/supplement-testing-cost - Published per-sample prices and pre-compliance vs ISO 17025 guidance.
- Insights: https://openchemworks.com/insights/ - Guides on amino acid testing, panels, prices and choosing a lab.
- Creatine gummy testing cost and degradation: https://openchemworks.com/insights/creatine-gummy-testing-cost-and-degradation - Why creatine gummies fail labels, creatinine cyclization, matrix spike recovery, and $180 CR-1G pricing.
- Repligen (908 Devices) REBEL vs send-out spent media analysis: https://openchemworks.com/insights/repligen-rebel-vs-send-out-spent-media-analysis - Comparing at-line CE-MS vs $1,990 RUN-1 HPLC (overnight turnaround available, with expedited service on request).

- Amino acid testing for food products: https://openchemworks.com/applications/food-testing - Free vs total amino acids for food products, sample amounts and prices.
- Amino acid unit converter: https://openchemworks.com/tools/amino-acid-unit-converter - Convert between µM, mg/L, mg/100 mL and mg/g for the AA-1 amino acids.
- Spent-media depletion & ammonia estimator: https://openchemworks.com/tools/spent-media-depletion-estimator - Model CHO/HEK293 amino acid exhaustion timing, separate 37 C glutamine thermal decay from cellular qAA uptake, and project chemical ammonia buildup.
- Protein label & amino-spiking calculator: https://openchemworks.com/tools/protein-amino-spiking-checker - Compute synthetic N x 6.25 protein inflation from free glycine, taurine, creatine, glutamine or arginine vs intact protein.
- Analyzer or send-out calculator: https://openchemworks.com/tools/analyzer-vs-send-out-calculator - Compare in-house analyzer cost per sample with published send-out prices.
